svg.title: Microverse software architecture
svg.desc: Learner, browser app modules, local server, external Meta and Baseten APIs, and build and CI. Generated from docs/architecture.drawio.
svg.text: Browser app: static HTML, CSS and ES modules (no framework, no build step)
terrain.js, art.js: map shapes, deer variants
rig.js: cuts legs from the image
rig-review.js: human review of the rig
Local server: Node, 127.0.0.1 only, keeps the API key
meta-provider.mjs: Muse Image and SAM calls
creature-budget.mjs and runtime/*.json ledgers: every paid call reserves first, fails closed, never retries
no server, no key, no uploads
